_about: George Borrow's own books (Lavengro, The Romany Rye, The Bible in Spain, Wild Wales and others); his translations are on Lane C's borrow-translations shelf: every English text under the name at Gutenberg that no other shelf holds. Added 2026-10-18 at the coordinator's relay of Adam's keep-going message (Adam may veto). Dates are as each title page gives them; many texts are undated.
